title: Nebius x NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon
description: Welcome to the Nebius x NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon Build a working AI system on open, independent infrastructure, and own the whole thing. The NVIDIA x Nebius Global AI Hackathon is for AI builders, ML engineers, founders, and anyone shipping practical, high-performance AI. You'll build with NVIDIA open source models served on Nebius through Nebius Token Factory, on high performance GPU infrastructure. Experiment with new ideas, push the boundaries of open source AI, and submit a project for a chance to win prizes and recognition. Join fellow builders for technical onboarding, casual workshops, team formation, focused build time, and feedback as you participate in the Global AI Hackathon. Find your nearby city/event here !

title: haxfinity
description: 12–13 December 2026 10:30 AM, 12 December – 10:30 AM, 13 December Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous), Nilambur, Kerala Prizes:Exciting prizes — details to be announced Team size:2–4 participants Participation: Free Build real solutions, solve meaningful problems, and create something that works. HAXFINITY is a 24-hour hackathon conducted as part of XTHRON ’26, the annual IT fest of the Department of Computer Science, Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous), Nilambur. Students from different colleges and backgrounds will identify problems, build software prototypes, and present their work to judges. The event includes the opening ceremony, a 21-hour project-building window, demonstrations, judging, and awards. There is no compulsory theme. Teams may choose any problem and build a software solution using any suitable technology. Build a product, tool, or prototype that solves a real problem or explores an idea. Build an application using machine learning, generative AI, NLP, computer vision, data analysis, or another AI-related technology. Build technology that improves people’s lives — for example, in education, healthcare, accessibility, sustainability, financial inclusion, or community welfare. Detailed judging criteria will be published before the event. Building window:*11:00 AM, 12 December – 8:00 AM, 13 December (21 hours). Students from all colleges, streams, and experience levels are welcome. You can participate as a beginner, developer, designer, or creative problem-solver. Interests in AI, cybersecurity, web, mobile, cloud, or social-impact technology are all welcome. Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous) Santhigramam, Eranhimangad Nilambur, Malappuram, Kerala — 679329 Check-in and travel details will be shared with registered participants. Opportunity to demo projects to judges Competition Rules All project-specific development must happen during the official building window. Teams may arrive with an idea, but pre-built projects cannot be submitted. Open-source libraries, APIs, datasets, and templates are allowed, subject to their licences. Teams must disclose pre-existing components and AI tools used. Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools are allowed across all tracks. Teams should submit early; late submissions may not be accepted. A working prototype or meaningful demonstration is expected. Teams must be able to explain their technology, process, third-party components, and contributions. Projects must not violate copyright, privacy, security, or applicable law. Organisers may disqualify entries for plagiarism, misconduct, unsafe content, or rule violations. All participants are expected to maintain a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming environment. Participants can approach the organising team for assistance or to report a concern. title: CODERAVE 2.0
description: CODE • COLLABORATE • INNOVATE - The SLIET Annual Hackathon. Organized by Internwell SLIET Club Venue: Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology (SLIET), Longowal, Punjab Mode: Hybrid — Online (All India) + Offline (SLIET Campus) Coderave 2.0 is a national-level hybrid hackathon designed to bring together innovative minds, passionate developers, designers, and problem-solvers to transform ideas into impactful technology solutions. Organized by Internwell SLIET Club, this edition offers students an opportunity to demonstrate their creativity, technical expertise, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities through a competitive, time-bound development experience. The hackathon welcomes teams from colleges and universities across India through its online participation track, while SLIET students can participate in the offline campus track. Shortlisted teams will present their ideas through PPT pitches, followed by an intensive 24-hour open-source development challenge in which participants will build, test, and demonstrate their solutions. Whether you are interested in web development, app development, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, data science, or other emerging technologies, Coderave 2.0 is your platform to innovate, collaborate, and compete. Round 1 — Registration and PPT Submission: The Team Leader registers the complete team and submits the project proposal PPT. Round 2 — PPT Evaluation and Shortlisting: Judges evaluate submissions based on innovation, problem relevance, feasibility, technical approach, potential impact, and presentation quality. Round 3 — PPT Pitch: Shortlisted online teams(Max 20 team) pitch through an online meeting. Shortlisted SLIET teams pitch offline on campus on 13 February. Round 4 — 24-Hour Open-Source Hackathon: Selected teams(Both online and offline track) build their solutions within the official development window. Round 5 — Final Submission and Evaluation: Teams submit their working solution, source code repository, demo video, and other required deliverables. Judges evaluate the final projects and announce the winners. The hackathon is an opportunity to turn ideas into functional prototypes within 24 hours. Teams are expected to develop their solutions during the official event window and use open-source tools, libraries, and technologies wherever possible. Participants must maintain a project repository, provide clear documentation, and ensure that their work is demonstrable. Teams must disclose third-party components and follow applicable open-source licences. Previously developed work must be declared, and the core solution must comply with the organizers' originality requirements. Exciting prizes, goodies, certificates, and recognition await outstanding teams. Final awards, prize amounts, sponsor benefits, and certificate eligibility will be announced through the official event communication. Note: The dates above are provisional until officially confirmed. The year, registration deadline, online pitch schedule, and final evaluation schedule will be published by the organizers. Bring your idea, build your team, and turn innovation into impact. Register for Coderave 2.0 and take your first step toward creating something extraordinary. title: HACK WITH GDG S4
description: Hack With GDG S4 is the fourth season of the flagship hackathon organized by Google Developer Groups – KSR College of Engineering (GDG KSRCE) . The event brings together developers, designers, innovators, and problem-solvers to transform ideas into impactful solutions through technology. Due to unforeseen circumstances, Hack With GDG S4 has been postponed . The revised dates for the hackathon will be announced soon. Participants are requested to follow our official communication channels for updates regarding the new schedule, submission deadlines, and other event-related announcements. Participants will submit their project idea in PPT/PDF format for evaluation. Teams will be evaluated based on their problem statement, proposed solution, innovation, feasibility, and potential impact. A working prototype is not mandatory at this stage, but prior technical work may be considered an advantage. Selected teams will advance to the offline hackathon. Selected teams will participate in a 36-hour offline hackathon , where they will build and demonstrate their solutions on-site. Hack With GDG S4 welcomes participants across different skill levels and backgrounds. Both beginners and experienced participants are welcome to participate. The hackathon follows an Open Innovation approach. title: Lean In Hacks 8.0
description: Lean In Hacks is an annual flagship hackathon of Lean In IGDTUW - the first chapter of Lean In India. Lean In Hacks is a beginner-friendly hackathon and has a place for everyone wanting to learn, build, share, and grow in their lives through their unique ideas. Our hackathon journey started in 2020 when we conducted the first edition of Lean In Hacks to give grounds to new thoughts and tools to animate the imaginative and critical thinking side of developers. This time, hackers from any college can participate in our hackathon, which will be held in hybrid mode . The only requirement is to have at least 1 female in your team ! Hackers will be given the weekend to build their product online and the top teams will be given a chance to pitch in the offline mode . As a beginner-friendly hackathon, we offer a dedicated Beginner’s Track exclusively for first-time hackers. This track is designed as an ideathon for first-year students , aimed at fostering innovative thinking, creativity, and confidence in problem-solving. title: PayPal AI Hackathon
description: About the challenge PayPal already moves money for millions of people and businesses, every day, all over the world. This hackathon is us opening that platform up and asking what happens when you put AI behind the wheel. New agents, new ways to pay and get paid, tools nobody's built yet. We want to see what you make of it. AI is changing how people build, buy, sell, work, connect, and move money. Now it's your turn to imagine what comes next. Build What's Next with PayPal and AI is a global online hackathon inviting developers, designers, founders, students, and builders to create something new using PayPal and AI . There are no prescribed problem statements and no set of tracks. Build an agent, an app, an automation, a new payment experience, a business tool, a social product, or something we haven't thought of yet. The only fundamental requirement: your project must meaningfully use both PayPal and AI . Why Join? Build something ambitious — Turn an idea into a working project using PayPal and AI. Explore what’s next — Experiment with new ways people, businesses, and AI agents can interact with money and payments. Win part of $ 69,750 in total prizes — Compete for overall prizes and special awards across creativity, impact, execution, and more. Show what you can build — Put your project in front of PayPal judges, developers, and the wider hackathon community. Learn by building — Explore PayPal APIs, AI tools, agents, automations, and emerging development workflows. Build your way — Join individually or as a team, and start something new or meaningfully advance an existing project. Get started Get a PayPal Developer account (5 minutes) Review example projects and brainstorm your own (30 minutes) Webinars Oct 6th 9am PT - 9:45am PT ~ Start building with PayPal Recording Oct 7th 9am PT - 9:30am PT ~ Power Your PayPal Hackathon Project with APIMatic Context Plugins Oct 12th 7am PT - 7:45am PT ~ Build a payments dashboard without building a dashboard Oct 13th 1am PT - 2am PT ~ Start building with PayPal

title: Learn AR with SPECS
description: Design an augmented reality app for glasses, and let an AI coding agent build it in Lens Studio. You don't need the glasses, because everything runs in Lens Studio's preview on your laptop. You'll get a short concept video, a skill pack for your coding agent, a live build session, and a live project review. $2,500 in prizes each round. ABOUT THE CHALLENGE Screens won't be the only place we use computers. Glasses are coming, and building for them is different from building for a laptop or a phone. Most first tries at AR end up as a website floating in front of your face. Good AR does things a laptop can't do: It shares your view. The camera sees what you see, so the app can respond to it. It draws in the world. Content sits on the table, over the stove, at real size, right where it belongs. It leaves your body free. Your hands stay available and your eyes stay up, so you can keep doing the real thing. Coding agents can now build a working Lens from a good description. So the hard part is deciding what's worth building and how it should feel. That's what this hackathon teaches. You'll install our Devpost Learn skill pack in your coding agent. It interviews you about your idea, checks it against AR design best practices, and writes a design brief. Then Snap's CLAD agents build the Lens in Lens Studio from that brief, and you try it in the preview. You'll finish with a working Lens, the plan behind it, and a way of thinking about AR you can use on every project after this one. WHY JOIN Learn what makes a good AR app, from the design decisions an agent can't make for you. Build for SPECS, Snap's AR glasses, without owning a pair. Try Snap's newest agent tools: CLAD, the Lens Studio MCP, and LEAF testing. Get help from real people in a live build session and a live project review. Compete to win a share of $2,500. First place takes $1,250, and every winner gets a feature in the Devpost newsletter and on Devpost's socials. Everyone who submits an eligible project gets a Devpost Learn badge and a special role in the Devpost Discord. GET STARTED You'll need a computer that runs Lens Studio, Node.js and Git, and a coding agent that supports skills. Set up your tools with the quick start on the Resources tab: your coding agent, Lens Studio, the Lens Studio MCP, and the CLAD plugin. Can't sign in to the developer platform on Lens Studio 5.24? Use Lens Studio 5.23.2 instead. Watch the concept video (at the top of this page). It's short, and it covers the design ideas the judges look for. Install the skill pack: npx skills add challengepost/learn-specs --all -y. Then open your coding agent and say "Run the plan-lens skill." It takes it from there. Join the SPECS channel in the Devpost Discord for questions and to see what other builders are making. Register for the Build for SPECS: AR Design with Lens Studio and CLAD live build session on Thursday, Oct 29 at 12PM ET. We build a Lens start to finish. It's recorded if you can't make it. Come to the SPECS Live Review: Inside the Judging Criteria on Thursday, Nov 5 at 12PM ET. We review a few projects in progress against the judging criteria, so you still have time to act on the feedback before the deadline. Want yours reviewed live? Post it in the #devpost-learn-feedback channel in the Discord and tag it "Learn AR with SPECS" and "Will It Ship." Stuck? Ask in the Discord channel. Setup help, the FAQ, and event details are on the Resources tab.

title: UGREEN Hackathon 2026 on AI NAS
description: UGREEN is opening AI NAS to developers through UGOS and Skills Hub . Powered by UGOS , UGREEN's own Linux-based operating system, UGREEN AI NAS brings local storage, computing, and AI capabilities together in one platform. UGOS makes it easy to keep your data secure, find and organize your files, and get more done with AI. With the UGOS Skill Creation Tool and your preferred AI assistant, you can create custom Skills that use supported NAS capabilities to organize files, find information, and automate everyday tasks. UGREEN Skills Hub gives developers the freedom to explore new ideas, create innovative tools, and expand what AI NAS can do. You bring the ideas. We'll help you build them. Access developer resources and technical support, with opportunities to win prizes, gain exposure through UGREEN, and explore future collaborations. No UGREEN NAS is required to enter. Finalists will receive free access to a UGREEN AI NAS iDX6011 Pro environment for final development, testing, and validation. The Hackathon has two rounds: Round 1 (open to all): Share your idea and an early build of your Skill. You do not need a NAS to enter. Download the UGREEN Skill Developer Package. Then submit a short PDF and a Pre-test Skill Package (ZIP). Round 2 (Finalists only): UGREEN will select up to 30 Finalists. Each Finalist gets one assigned testing day of free remote access to a real UGREEN AI NAS to install, test, and polish their Skill. Finalists then submit their final Skill and a short demo video to compete for $46,000 in cash prizes! Get Started: 🧠 Get to know UGREEN AI NAS . Learn what it can do. 💬 Join the UGREEN Community . 📦 Download the UGREEN Skill Developer Package . It has the tools and technical docs you need. You must use this package to build your Skill. 🛠️ Brush up on helpful skills . Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, Linux and Docker, AI agent and tool design, and file or media processing are all useful here. Why Participate 💰 Compete for $46,000 in cash prizes. Five winners will share the prize pool, including two Most Creative awards. 🚀 No NAS needed to start. Round 1 is open to everyone. You only need your idea, the Skill Developer Package, and your code . 🖥️ Test on real hardware for free. Each Finalist gets one assigned testing day of free remote access to a UGREEN AI NAS iDX6011 Pro. 🎨 Build what you care about. Choose from four tracks: work automation, personal memories, creative media, or your own original idea. 🤝 Connect with the UGREEN team. Access developer resources and technical support, with opportunities to win prizes, gain exposure through UGREEN, and explore future collaborations .

title: Codex x TwitchCon Hackathon
description: Twitch is the home of shared live experiences, and developers shape how streamers and their communities experience them. OpenAI and Twitch are teaming up to see what developers can build for the Twitch community with AI. In the Codex x TwitchCon Hackathon, you'll use OpenAI Codex to build useful and creative experiences for Twitch streamers and their community. Give chat a way to play along, help streamers create together, or add something new to enhance the content they stream. You’ll leave with a working project and hands-on experience building with Codex. The top 5 projects will be showcased on the Codex Booth stage at TwitchCon San Diego on November 15, where winners will be announced live. Why join? $25,000 in prizes , and a spot on the TwitchCon stage for the top 5 Build with Codex : tell Codex what you're building and let it help you get set up with the Twitch API, EventSub and chat Connect streamers and their community : build something streamers and viewers can use live on stream Get started Sign in to Codex and start a new thread for your project. You’ll need its session ID when you submit. Find everything you need to build at dev.twitch.tv . Not sure where to start? Get a chatbot running in minutes with the Example Chatbot guide Join the TwitchDev Discord and ask questions in the channel that fits what you're building. Say hi in #codex-twitchcon-hackathon channel for general questions and updates.

title: TUM Blockchain & AI Hackathon
description: AI agents are starting to act on their own: booking, negotiating, paying. The payment rails for that don't fully exist yet. This hackathon is about building the infrastructure and applications that let autonomous agents transact safely and instantly on-chain. Pick up to three tracks, build against the partner's challenge, and compete for its prize pool. TUM Blockchain Club has brought together 3,000+ builders, researchers and founders over the last four years, running Europe's largest student-led Web3 event. This year the hackathon sits inside TBC26: three days, two venues, one community, with the main conference and Bundesblock's Digital Assets Day running alongside. title: AWS Communication Developer Services (CDS) Agentic AI Partner Hackathon
description: Calling all AWS Partners! We are inviting you to build the next wave of conversational solutions on AWS Communication Developer Services (CDS)! AWS CDS enables AWS Partners to help customers engage users at a global scale through AWS End User Messaging (EUM) which includes Rich Communication Services (RCS), Short Message Services (SMS), and WhatsApp. It also includes Amazon Simple Email Service (SES). AWS CDS is the infrastructure that powers messaging across Amazon.com , Amazon Cognito, SNS, and Amazon Connect. AWS CDS is often used for one-time passwords (OTP), notifications, and rules-based chatbots that follow rigid scripts. We challenge you to think beyond this. The future of customer engagement is conversational: reaching customers in the channel (i.e. email vs. RCS vs. WhatsApp) they prefer, picking up right where the last conversation left off, and using two-way communication so customers tell you directly what they want and share signals that improve your products and services. Picture omnichannel experiences where a conversation starts in one channel and completes an action in another: a prescription refill reminder via SMS that lets the patient find and schedule the nearest pharmacy pickup through RCS with a tap, then sends dosage instructions via email, all without leaving the messaging experience. Push the boundaries. Build agentic solutions where AWS CDS is the communications backbone, powered by AI such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Surprise us with your real customer and industry solutions! Why You Should Participate Innovate with AWS CDS . Get hands-on with AWS CDS combined with agentic AI powered by Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Solve Real Customer Problems . Create agentic solutions tied to customer and industry use cases that can scale across your customer base. Package your hackathon submission into a repeatable offering, list it on AWS Marketplace, and win AWS Specialist GTM and enablement support to accelerate real customer deals. Win Big . Compete for your share of $40,000 USD in cash prizes, in addition to an opportunity for a joint case study and 1:1 access to AWS Specialists to build and grow your AWS CDS practice and hackathon solution. Visibility for Your Organization . Winners will be announced via Devpost and the top winner will be offered a joint case study with AWS. Drive awareness and new leads to your practice. Direct Access to AWS Specialists . Join live webinars and weekly office hours to ask questions, get feedback, and shape the services roadmap. How to Get Started Now Brainstorm Your Idea . Think outside the box to improve customer communication experience through AWS CDS. Review the Tech Stack . Familiarize yourself with the AWS CDS services and how to pair them with agentic AI frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. See the Requirements below. Form Your Team (Optional). Find collaborators within the same AWS Partner organization who are excited to improve customer problems through AWS CDS. Diverse skillsets in development, architecture, and customer engagement can go a long way. Start Building . Stand up an RCS agent within 5 minutes to develop an entire solution, decide later to use RCS or phone numbers for each country you’re serving, and expand from there.

title: Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026

This year’s eight-week challenge calls on Start program members to build the next generation of Entertainment, Gaming, and Productivity experiences for Meta VR devices – including Meta VR Glasses and Meta Quest. We’re looking for hands-first apps that make interaction more natural and gameplay more intuitive than ever before. Last year, over 2,900 developers joined the competition and delivered more than 650 submissions that pushed the boundaries of immersive technology. This year, we’re raising the bar again. Whether you’re a first-time Start developer with a breakthrough idea or a seasoned creator ready to showcase what’s possible with the latest platform capabilities, this is your moment to help redefine the future of VR. Here’s what’s waiting for you: 🤝 Build hands-first. Design experiences powered by hand interactions that feel natural, responsive, and deeply immersive—no controllers required. 🛠️ Explore new tech. Take advantage of the latest OS capabilities and device features across Meta VR Glasses and Meta Quest, accelerate your development with AI tooling, including Meta VR CLI. 🌍 Join a global community. Boost your skills through mentor programming, collaborate with fellow developers, share insights, and learn from a thriving network of experienced VR developers. 🏆 Compete for $1M in cash prizes with top prizes of $100,000. The future of VR is in your hands literally . We can’t wait to see what you build. GETTING STARTED If you’re not already a member of the Start program, apply now to join the competition. title: YouCam API Skin AI & eCommerce VTO Hackathon
description: Unleash Your Innovation: Shape the Future of Skincare and eCommerce. Calling all builders, creators, and visionaries: it’s time to completely reimagine the way we shop. The YouCam API Skin AI & eCommerce VTO Hackathon is your launchpad. We’re unlocking our most advanced, market-tested AI and AR infrastructure just for you. It's time to build the real-world, scalable products, including cutting-edge Agentic AI workflows. We’re challenging you to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Seamlessly integrate YouCam APIs into your wildest ideas, whether that means engineering a self-learning styling assistant, a hyper-personalized skin analysis tool, or an entirely new solution to everyday consumer pain points. Bring your boldest concepts to the table, and we’ll back your vision with serious prize money. Are you up for the challenge? 🎉 🎉 Share & Earn Bonus: Share your hackathon project and earn bonus API units! click HERE About the challenge All solutions must integrate at least one [ YouCam API ] into a functional web or mobile prototype that delivers clear consumer value. We want fresh, unexpected solutions to real-world pain points in beauty, fashion, or eCommerce—not surface-level wrappers. You can even take it a step further by building scalable products that include cutting-edge Agentic AI workflows. Pick the topic that best fits your vision and submit: Skin AI: People don't wonder about their skin in the abstract; they wonder right before a purchase, right after a bad breakout, or right when they're standing in front of a mirror deciding whether a product is working. Build something that meets that moment. Use YouCam's Skin AI, alone or combined with other YouCam APIs, to help users understand their skin and know exactly what to do next. eCommerce VTO: Beauty and fashion decisions rarely happen in isolation; what someone wears and how their looks are part of the same self-image. Build something that brings Virtual Try-On together into one seamless, intuitive experience. We want to see what's possible when both capabilities work as one to reimagine the way we shop. Why Join Build with YouCam API. Access AI Skin Analysis and generative Apparel Virtual Try-On, the same models powering 800+ global beauty and fashion brands, on a standard REST API that drops into any stack. Get free API units to build , deploy, and demo. Every registered participant receives 1,000 free API units just for signing up. Win cash , API credits , and real visibility . Click here to sign up and verify your email. (2 minutes) Claim Your Free 1,000 YouCam API Units. Click here and go to Account > Redeem Code > Enter the redeem code (3 minutes) 1,000 API Units will be added to your account immediately.

title: Qloo Agentic Hackathon
description: BREAKING NEWS!!!! On November 5th, the Top 3 Finalists will appear on air with Jason Calacanis, Cedric the Entertainer, and Alex Elias, who will pick the winner! All three finalists will present their ideas to the judges, answer questions, and learn the results in real time. You won't find a bigger, more receptive, more connected audience to highlight what you've built and showcase how your idea can explode from submission to actual business! The three finalists will be notified of their status very soon after the Hackathon closes. Note that this means the finalists must be able to appear, and must be available for preparation prior to the appearance. More details will be provided to the finalists when they are notified. About the challenge Agents are getting smarter, but they're culturally blind. They can reason, plan, and execute — but ask them what to recommend, what to build, or what people actually want, and they're guessing. This hackathon is about fixing that. Build an agentic tool, an agent-powered app, or wire Qloo into an agent that already exists. Use our API and taste graph — 250M+ entities across music, film, dining, fashion, and more — to give your agent something most never get: real cultural grounding. We're not looking for demos of what LLMs can already do. We're looking for the thing that only works because it knows what people love. Show us the use case where cultural intelligence is the difference between "technically functional" and "actually good." Build it, ship it, blow our minds. Get your API key here to get started: https://docs.qloo.com/reference/qloo-llm-hackathon-developer-guide#getting-your-api-key BONUS CHALLENGE UNLOCKED!!!!! Entrepreneur extraordinaire JASON CALACANIS -- JCal the Bestie himself -- will personally invest an additional $25,000 into his favorite entry. The competition will get tougher, but even more rewarding for the potential winner. Good luck, and get coding!
